_comment: Generic defaults. Put the real brand in ~/.video2aeo/brand.json (any subset of these keys; it is deep-merged over this file) – never commit it. The setup skill writes it. Values marked {{...}} must be filled (channel, topics) or are blanked when skipped (organization name/logo, schedule, disclaimer_url, social_links); the validator lists any that remain. Footer tokens: {SCHEDULE}, {DISCLAIMER_URL}, {SOCIAL_LINKS} are filled from description.* (a line whose value is empty is dropped); description.header (verbatim, optional) is always the first thing in the description; {PROMO} is where description.promo (links, messages, ads) goes when promo_position is 'end' – 'top' puts it above the answer.
